basic_details.job_title: TMC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 7 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for TMC Recruitment 2026 is on 4 November 2026 between 10.00 AM and 11.00 AM at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) - 842004. Tata Memorial Centre (TMC), Mumbai invites Indian Nationals for 7 posts of Medical Officer (Junior Resident) for Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Muzaffarpur, for a fixed period up to 31 July 2027, with a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 1,11,132/- (Advt. No. HBCH&RC/MUZ/MO/2026/11, dated 26 October 2026).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post, Medical Officer (Junior Resident), with 7 vacancies. The qualification is an MBBS degree recognized by the National Medical Commission . Candidates with experience in Oncology will be preferred. The walk-in is open to Indian Nationals. The age limit is 45 years. Age and experience will be reckoned as on the date of the walk-in interview, 4 November 2026. Each selected Medical Officer (Junior Resident) will have to deposit a security deposit of Rs. 1,11,132/- (Rupees One Lakh Eleven Thousand One Hundred Thirty Two Only). The security deposit will be refunded after the tenure is completed successfully. The appointment is for a fixed period up to 31 July 2027. content_sections.heading: Online Interview for Outstation Candidates
content_sections.text: Outstation candidates may email a request for an online interview to [email protected] by 2 November 2026, up to 3:00 PM. All other candidates report in person at the Muzaffarpur venue on 4 November 2026 between 10.00 AM and 11.00 AM.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is for a fixed period up to 31 July 2027. Candidates with experience in Oncology will be preferred. The security deposit is paid only by selected candidates and is refunded only after the tenure is completed successfully. Questions about the walk-in can be made on the phone number printed in the notice: 9472377509. Legal jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Muzaffarpur only.

faq.question: Q1. When is the TMC Medical Officer (Junior Resident) walk-in interview at Muzaffarpur?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 4 November 2026. Candidates report between 10.00 AM and 11.00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the venue for the TMC Muzaffarpur walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The venue is Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) - 842004. The phone number given in the notice is 9472377509.

faq.question: Q3. How many Medical Officer (Junior Resident) vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies for Medical Officer (Junior Resident) at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Muzaffarpur.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for the TMC Medical Officer (Junior Resident) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS degree recognized by the National Medical Commission. Candidates with experience in Oncology will be preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the TMC Medical Officer (Junior Resident) post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years, reckoned as on the date of the walk-in interview, 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Who gets age relaxation, and how much?
faq.answer: SC/ST candidates get 5 years, OBC candidates get 3 years and Physically Handicapped candidates get 10 years of relaxation.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of a Medical Officer (Junior Resident) at HBCH&RC Muzaffarpur?
faq.answer: The post carries a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 1,11,132/-. Selected candidates must also pay a security deposit of the same amount, which is refunded after the tenure is completed successfully.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring your Bio-Data, a recent passport size photograph, a copy of your PAN card, your Aadhar Card, original certificates and sets of attested copies of all certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Can outstation candidates take the interview online?
faq.answer: Yes. Outstation candidates may email a request for an online interview to [email protected] by 2 November 2026, up to 3:00 PM.

faq.question: Q10. Is the TMC Medical Officer (Junior Resident) appointment permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is for a fixed period up to 31 July 2027.
